ABEL local semantic masks

Runtime: ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0 (Microsoft), MIT.
See LICENSE-ONNX.txt and ThirdPartyNotices.txt. Rebuild with npm ci and
npm run vendor:segmentation. integrity.json records the shipped hashes.
Single-thread WASM runs in a dedicated worker; no WebGPU requirement.

Sky: DETR (Facebook Research), Apache-2.0.
Original model: https://huggingface.co/facebook/detr-resnet-50-panoptic
Original code: https://github.com/facebookresearch/detr
ONNX conversion: Xenova/detr-resnet-50-panoptic, revision
ea24b2d4e0bfae31f0a1299ba3fb892a2df064de (FP16, 86,559,030 bytes).
The smaller INT8 export was rejected after real inference produced identical
query masks. FP16 preserved the distinct sky/mountain masks of FP32.
COCO panoptic sky-other-merged is category 187 (includes clouds), NOT old
COCO-Stuff sky-other 157. The converted config's LABEL_187 is incomplete;
the authoritative taxonomy is:
https://github.com/cocodataset/panopticapi/blob/7bb4655548f98f3fedc07bf37e9040a992b054b0/panoptic_coco_categories.json
Mask decoding follows the original DETR PostProcessPanoptic: class confidence
filter at 0.85, then argmax across raw query mask logits. No blue-color heuristic.
https://github.com/facebookresearch/detr/blob/29901c51d7fe8712168b8d0d64351170bc0f83e0/models/segmentation.py
Carion et al., End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers, ECCV 2020.

Subject: U²-Netp (Xuebin Qin et al.), Apache-2.0.
Original code/weights: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
Qin et al., U²-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient Object
Detection, Pattern Recognition 106 (2020), 107404.
Verbatim ONNX mirror of the rembg release: https://huggingface.co/edgetools/u2netp
Revision 25dee37ab19c5b6ad64ba6578eba63f1ae07720c (4,574,861 bytes).
Rem bg's surrounding application is not included.

See LICENSE-MODELS.txt (Apache-2.0). Model weights are not bundled or
redistributed in this repository. They are downloaded by the browser only
on an explicit detection request from the pinned public Hugging Face URLs
in js/segmentation.js, SHA-256 verified, and best-effort browser-cached.
No photo is sent to the model host. No cloud review provider is called.
The host still sees ordinary asset-request network metadata.

SegFormer ADE20k and BRIA RMBG are deliberately NOT used here: their
original model licenses restrict use. Subject detection is general
salient-foreground detection, not portrait-only or an all-object detector.
